title: Real-Time Collaborative Editor
description: A Google Docs-style editor with real-time multi-user collaboration using Socket.io and operational transforms to handle concurrent edits without conflicts.

title: ERPLAG Compiler
description: Complete compiler for ERPLAG in C — lexer, parser, semantic analyzer, and code generator. Written from scratch with no libraries, just pointer arithmetic and pain.

title: chotu — URL Shortener
description: A URL shortener service built with Spring Boot. Clean REST API, redirect tracking, and enough Spring annotations to make an enterprsie architect proud.

title: ASCII Image Converter
description: Converts any image into ASCII art. Supports a CLI tool and a Django REST API so you can make your photos look like a 1980s terminal. Deployed with proper WSGI and everything.

title: Spring Boot E-Commerce API
description: RESTful product catalog and shopping cart API with CRUD, image uploads, and keyword search. Uses an in-memory database that forgets everything on restart, just like me after meetings.

title: Packet Sniffer
description: A Java network tool for capturing and inspecting live traffic, with port scanning and basic traffic analysis. Written when I wanted to understand what was actually happening on the wire.
